translation: Flavor sweet, slightly warm, not poisonous. Its chief actions are to treat loss of urine without restraint, men's weak feet with lumbar pain, wind-pathogen, dripping discharge (淋露), scant qi, dimming eyes, strengthen the spine and benefit bending and stretching; women's injury of the center, and heaviness of the joints. One name is 強膂, one name is 扶蓋, ...
